hero.title:
Flavour, carried
since 1995
hero.lede: We carry forward the journey of flavour Metin Hançerlioğlu began in Erdemli, with our traditional way of making and the mastery of years.

philosophy.label: Our philosophy
philosophy.title: Unchanging quality, mastery from one generation to the next
philosophy.p1: Since 1995 we have brought our traditional recipes together with ingredients we choose with care and with the experience of years.
philosophy.p2: Without compromising on quality, we aim to offer the same care and the same flavour in every product.
philosophy.p3: We go on toward the future open to what is new, while keeping the values we took from our past.

legacy.caption: Metin Hançerlioğlu, at the marble counter, Erdemli.
legacy.title: A journey begun by a master
legacy.p1: The story of Hançerlioğlu was born in 1995, with the journey of flavour that Metin Hançerlioğlu began in Erdemli.
legacy.p2: His love of the craft, the value he gave to labour and his sense of quality are the foundation of the Hançerlioğlu name today.
legacy.p3: Our brand, grown over the years, goes on, keeping the values we received from our founder.
legacy.alt: Hançerlioğlu — Metin Hançerlioğlu at the marble counter of the Erdemli workshop
legacy.name: Metin Hançerlioğlu

heritage.title: Hançerlioğlu, from then until now
heritage.intro: The journey of flavour that began in Erdemli in 1995 continues to grow, still bound to our traditions.
heritage.alt1995: Hançerlioğlu — Metin Hançerlioğlu at the counter he founded in 1995
heritage.alt2025: Hançerlioğlu — a tray of baklava in the Erdemoğlu Boulevard workshop, 2025
heritage.m1Text: The journey of flavour began when Metin Hançerlioğlu laid the foundations of our brand in Erdemli.
heritage.m2Text: With our new branch we widened the ground we serve, and developed our capacity and the variety of what we make.
heritage.m3Text: We are carrying the story that began in Erdemli beyond the borders of Turkey. With our first branch abroad, to open in Aleppo, we step onto a journey of international growth.
heritage.m4Text: Keeping our traditions and our sense of quality, we aim to meet our guests with the flavours of Hançerlioğlu in other cities and countries.

craft.title: Mastery, drawn from tradition
craft.intro: We bring the experience of years together with ingredients we choose with care and with our traditional ways of making.
craft.baklavaText: Paper-thin yufka, Antep pistachio and a şerbet prepared with mastery. We bring the traditional flavour of baklava to the table.
craft.kuneText: Crisp kadayıf, our own künefe cheese and a balanced şerbet. We serve the traditional flavour of künefe warm.
craft.katmerText: We enrich our traditional katmer — paper-thin dough, kaymak and Antep pistachio — with further flavours.
craft.altBaklava: Hançerlioğlu — a tray of pistachio baklava, forty leaves
craft.altKune: Hançerlioğlu — künefe, the cheese pulling strand by strand
craft.altKatmer: Hançerlioğlu — katmer dough opened thin, with cream and pistachio
craft.intro2: Every product is prepared with the same care and the same sense of quality.
craft.kadayifText: We bring the kadayıf we prepare in the traditional way together with ingredients we choose with care.

house.title: A tradition of flavour that began in Erdemli

house.p3: For us, every product is a part of labour, of mastery and of the experience of years.

cat.katmerNote: The dough is thrown into the air until it is thin enough to be read through a table. Katmer belongs to the hour before the city wakes; every form below is a separate answer to the same fold.
cat.kuneNote: Hammered copper over an open fire, and cheese drawn that morning. The master watches the sound, not the clock: when the sizzle drops half a tone, the plate is finished.
cat.kadayifNote: The strand of the künefe is parted from the cheese and left to stand on its own. Butter, pistachio and patience. There is nothing else to hide behind.
cat.baklavaNote: Forty leaves on the tray, each opened until a printed page could be read through it. The house has never changed that number, and it has never been asked to.
cat.iceNote: Salep and mastic are turned slowly enough that the result is taken with a knife, not a scoop. Kaymak is lifted at four in the morning; everything in this catalogue that carries it begins there.
cat.drinksNote: What is carried to the table beside the plate. Two of them are made here and take as long as any product in this catalogue. The rest arrive cold, in glass, without being asked twice.
cat.otherNote: Recipes prepared with the same care, beyond the principal categories.

catalog.close: Forty-two products, one measure. What is not in this catalogue is not made in this house.
